_comment: Synthetic RiskReader answers for P9's reset fixture: scenario-safe.json's benign action S (0.001 MON with empty calldata to the deployer, inside agent 1984's mandate), after a demo reset (pnpm demo scene 3b). Not read from any chain.

What differs from scenario-safe.json: the mandate was set 300 blocks before P (mandate.setAtBlock), and the 6,000-block permission window holds the reset's four events, oldest first: the previous take's MandateSet (P-1500), AgentKeySet to the rogue key (P-1200), AgentKeySet back to the hot key (P-400), and the stored mandate's own MandateSet (P-300). Every one is at or before the current mandate's MandateSet, so recent_permission_events marks each afterMandate: false and mandate-v1 passes (prerequisite 100). Their txHash values are made up.
trace is one callTracer CALL from the gate to the deployer; its root frame's input is filled in with the variant's data ('0x').

accounts: code is present, and the nonce non-zero, from createdAtBlock on (code '0x' and nonce 0 before it, or always when createdAtBlock is null); balance is the balance at P. Any address not listed is an empty account. agents maps an agentId to its owner (anything else: no such agent); every agent has no reputation clients.
prerequisite is validator A's (mandate-v1) verdict at P: 100 with no reasons.

0x3EFEB3Cf2FB54A7D99abE90AaB786cE5A831a8.label: the target: the deployer, agent 1984's owner

0xEEEBBa55620afC42E9c88b5d962476367b8da3.label: DemoPassThrough, the mandate's other allowed target
